description: Report a problem with a Wever Labs tool into the review queue a person reads. Give tool_name, the catalog tool the report is about (up to 128 characters); expected, what you expected (up to 2,000); happened, what actually happened (up to 2,000); and optionally category, one of the six kinds in the schema, and context, such as the call shape or the error text (up to 4,000). Each report is stored with a feedback id and the time it was received, including a report about a tool name outside the catalog. An identical tool_name, expected and happened sent again within 10 minutes returns the first receipt. Returns a receipt with feedback_id, received_at and status. A human reviews every report, and no automatic changes are made to any tool from a report.

context.description: Anything else useful, such as the call shape or the error text.

tool_name.description: The catalog tool the report is about, for example wever_build-permit-check.

name: wever_feedback-submit
title: Report a tool problem
